newsitem.title: UK: Videotron panel recommends Bell Cable offer in UK.
newsitem.headline: Videotron panel recommends Bell Cable offer in UK.

text.p: Videotron Holdings Plc said on Wednesday an independent committee of its board recommended shareholders accept Bell Cablemedia Plc's offer to buy the rest of the UK cable unit, formerly owned by Canada's Le Groupe Videotron Ltee.
Le Groupe Videotron said on Tuesday it had completed the estimated $607 million sale of its 56 percent stake in Videotron to Bell Cablemedia.
After the deal, which was announced in October, Bell and its units held 82 percent of Videotron.
Videotron's committee recommended that shareholders accept Bell's $19.75 per American Depositary Share offer for the rest of Videotron's shares.
The acquisition formed part of the giant merger of the UK cable units of Videotron, Cable and Wireless Plc, NYNEX Corp, and BCE Inc with those of Mercury Communications.
